answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the marble of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the glacier re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The forge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
